name: The Farm
tagline: The Farm — Falls Creek Produce and Flowers
description: The Farm grows Strawberries, Raspberries, and Pumpkins in Alpena, MI. The farm is family-run, and its seasons run through spring, summer, and autumn. The harvest is typically at its peak in spring. Check the website or call ahead for current hours and what is in season.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Apr – Jun in this growing zone.
